one_sentence_story: Daniel Wegner proved in 1987 that commanding yourself 'Don't think of a white bear' forces an automatic mental radar to keep checking for white bears — triggering a rebound surge afterward unless you swap negation for one specific positive focus.
so_what_for_you: Drop 'Don't' instructions to your own brain under stress: replace 'Don't mess up / Don't think about X' with one concrete positive target ('Focus on a red Volkswagen / Aim dead center').
